blocks.name: MainInput
blocks.content:
uniform sampler2D baseMap : register(sn),
#if %BUMP_MAP
        uniform sampler2D bumpMap : register(sn),
  #if %BUMP_DIFFUSE && %DIFFUSE
        uniform sampler2D bumpMapDiffuse : register(sn),
  #endif
#endif

#if %TEMP_LM || %TEMP_DOT3LM
        uniform sampler2D lightMap : register(sn),
#endif        
#if %TEMP_DOT3LM
        uniform sampler2D lightDirMap : register(sn),
#endif
#if %TEMP_SPECULAR_OCCLUSIONMAP
        uniform sampler2D occlusionMap : register(sn),
#endif

#if %DIFFUSE
    # ifdef _LIGHT0_TYPE
        uniform float4 Diffuse[ _NUM_LIGHTS ] : register(c2),
    # endif
#endif

#if %SPECULAR
    # ifdef _LIGHT0_TYPE
        uniform float4 Specular[ _NUM_LIGHTS ] : register(c6),
        uniform float4 SpecularExp : register(c14),
    # endif
#endif        

#if %TEMP_AMBIENT && %ENVCMSPEC && %GLOSS_MAP
        uniform sampler2D glossMap : register(sn),
#elif %TEMP_AMBIENT && %ENVCMAMB && %ENVCM_MASKED
        uniform sampler2D glossMap : register(sn),
#elif %SPECULAR
  #if %GLOSS_MAP || %SPECULARPOW_GLOSSALPHA
        uniform sampler2D glossMap : register(sn),
  #endif
#endif        

#if %TEMP_AMBIENT
        uniform float4 Ambient : register(c0),
  #if %ENVCMAMB
        uniform samplerCUBE envMap : register(sn),
        uniform float4 Reflect,
  #elif %ENVCMSPEC
        uniform samplerCUBE envMap : register(sn),
        uniform float4 EnvMapParams,
        uniform float4 FresnelParams,
  #endif
#endif
    # ifdef _LIGHT0_TYPE
        uniform sampler2D attenMap : register(sn),
        uniform samplerCUBE projMap : register(sn),
    # endif

#if %TEMP_SPECULAR_OCCLUSIONMAP
    # ifdef _LIGHT0_TYPE
        uniform float4 OcclusionMasks[ _NUM_LIGHTS ] : register(c10),
    # endif
#endif

#if %OFFSETBUMPMAPPING
        uniform float4 BumpOffset,
#endif

    # ifdef _HDRLM
        uniform sampler2D lightMapHDR : register(sn),
    # endif
    # ifdef _3DC_A
        uniform sampler2D bumpHeight : register(sn),
    # endif
    # ifdef _SPEC_ANTIALIAS
        uniform sampler2D specularMap : register(sn),
    # endif
    
        uniform float4 AttenInfo : register(c1),
